Charging the Fee
Article (1)
a. A departure fee of seventy-five dirhams (AED 75.00) will be collected from every passenger departing the United Arab Emirates through Dubai airports. b. The following categories are hereby exempted from payment of the fee referred to in paragraph (a) of this Article: 1. passengers below the age of two (2) years; 2. on-duty pilots and cabin crew; 3. transit passengers whose arrival and departure flight number is the same ; and 4. transfer passengers whose final destination is not the United Arab Emirates and who se departure is within twenty-four (24) hours from the time of arrival.

body.answer: Law No. (9) of 2023 regulates the operation of autonomous vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai.

Under Dubai Law No. (9) of 2023, autonomous vehicles must be insured with an insurance company licensed to operate in the UAE. Specifically, the vehicle must be covered by a comprehensive insurance policy issued by such a licensed insurance company. This requirement is prescribed by the Director General and is necessary both for the initial licensing of the autonomous vehicle and for the renewal of its license.

body.answer: Under Law No. (9) of 2023 in Dubai, autonomous vehicles must be insured with an insurance company licensed to operate in the UAE. Specifically, for licensing, the vehicle must be covered by a comprehensive insurance policy issued by such a licensed insurance company. This requirement also applies for the renewal of the autonomous vehicle license, where the vehicle must continue to be covered by a comprehensive insurance policy from a licensed insurer in the UAE.
